name: @omp-dev-team/copilot-preset
description: GitHub Copilot model preset for Oh-My-Pi.
comment: Config-only plugin: ships a skill + a config.snippet.yml + pricing.md. It has no omp.extensions because model routing (modelRoles/retry.fallbackChains/enabledModels) is a USER setting that plugins cannot set automatically — paste config.snippet.yml into ~/.omp/agent/config.yml, or run install.sh --apply-config, which merges it key-by-key via scripts/lib/cfg.sh. Keep this version identical to .claude-plugin/plugin.json.
